name: Brier-score promotion delta
rationale: Method frozen W17: paired canonical-game Brier deltas and development-only variability; numeric value awaits materialized development evidence.

name: Log-loss promotion delta
rationale: Method frozen W17: paired log-loss deltas and development-only stability/tail review; numeric value awaits materialized evidence.

name: Calibration tolerance
rationale: Method frozen W17: development-only calibration intercept/slope/reliability variability; protected test cannot set tolerance.

name: Score/margin error promotion tolerance
rationale: Method frozen W17: paired score/margin error deltas and development-only sampling variability.

name: A&M specialization incremental-value threshold
rationale: Method frozen W17: A&M paired incremental value plus national nondegradation, with no-adjustment valid; numeric value pending.

name: BAS significance/stability threshold
rationale: Method frozen W17: null-first BAS effect/stability/multiplicity protocol; numeric criterion pending development evidence.

name: Feature-family promotion threshold
rationale: Method frozen W17: development-only walk-forward family ablation/stability; protected results cannot promote features post hoc.

name: Entity-resolution auto-accept confidence threshold
rationale: W07 disables fuzzy auto-accept because no labeled resolution benchmark exists; W19 may set only from labeled review/error evidence.

name: Source/domain completeness quality threshold
rationale: Domain/grain specific; global arbitrary completeness number prohibited.

name: Forecast freshness SLA
rationale: Set from actual update cadence/product expectations; stale state must always be visible.

name: Target-hardware peak-RAM budget
rationale: Measured on target 32GB environment before hard gate.

name: Target-hardware runtime budget
rationale: Measured for material workflows before hard gate.

name: Data-contract/quarantine tolerance
rationale: Schema/critical-field violations may be zero-tolerance while noncritical quality thresholds are domain-specific.

name: OOD trigger threshold
rationale: Method frozen W17: development OOD coverage/error/false-warning tradeoff; no numeric warning cutoff yet.

name: Model-disagreement warning threshold
rationale: Method frozen W17: development disagreement/error association and warning utility; no numeric warning cutoff yet.
